name: soundcloud
description: Searches and plays SoundCloud. Takes the client_id from the secret store, and otherwise discovers it itself. Gives the track's cover and its related tracks, and opens the track at a soundcloud.com link (a set's link waits for playlists). `*.sndcdn.com`: the web client's JS assets (a-v2), the old plain audio stream (cf-media) and the covers (i1) are under this domain; `playback.media-streaming.soundcloud.cloud` is where the HLS streams the app now plays live.
